artifact_observations.reasoning: The network of overhead wires exhibits physical implausibility. Wires merge into each other, change thickness abruptly, and lack logical connection points to poles. Some wires appear to float or terminate in mid-air without anchors.
The text on the white billboard is illegible and distorted, resembling AI-generated pseudo-text rather than coherent characters.
The road surface has a smeared, painterly texture lacking realistic asphalt grain. Background foliage shows slight melting/blending artifacts typical of generative models.
Some background elements appear slightly warped or inconsistently scaled relative to the foreground, suggesting weak geometric coherence in the depth field.
